messages:
ciara: Quick question - UK bank holiday falls on Sat 2026-12-26 so the observed day is Mon 2026-12-28. Our global year-end freeze is Dec 24-31. Can someone confirm if staff can bank the observed holiday to a floating day in Jan instead of taking Mon?

mohammed: Short answer: banking is allowed but depends on local statutes and our policy. In the UK, the observed substitute day is still a public holiday; we normally treat it as scheduled unless an employee requests a swap before the blackout cutoff.

neha: If they want to move it into the next tax year (i.e., take an alternate floating day in Jan), that is a carryover/one-time swap. Use Time-off Adjustment form and select "observed-holiday swap". Attach manager approval and note if this impacts any interview/on-call duties.

ciara: Payroll quirk: if someone pushes the public holiday into the next tax year, does it affect holiday entitlement calculations? I heard it can change the "statutory" holiday count for the tax year.

payroll: Good catch. Moving an observed public holiday into the next tax year doesn't change statutory entitlement but affects how we record the period. For year-end reporting we need the event in the tax-year bucket. If you request a swap across the tax-year boundary, mark the form field "cross_tax_year: yes" so Payroll can tag it for reporting. Otherwise it may be auto-assigned to the original tax year by the system.

mohammed: Also note the blackout: swaps submitted and approved before Dec 23 are treated as scheduled. After that, manager+People Ops sign-off required and we may need a coverage plan.

ciara: One more: can people "bank" the observed holiday as a floating holiday (to use later) or is it only a direct date swap?

neha: We allow both, but banking into a floating day requires manager agreement and must be selected on the form as "bank to float". That uses the employee's floating-holiday allotment; if they don't have float remaining we treat it as a carryover exception and route to Payroll.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Year-end blackout for unscheduled PTO = Dec 24-31 UTC. Submit swaps/banking before Dec 23 to avoid escalations. Link: https://redwood.example.com/hr/year-end-policy

ciara: Thanks. Manager approved the bank-to-float option and I filed the Time-off Adjustment (submitted 2699011238) with "cross_tax_year: yes" and attached the approval. Also added coverage note for recruiting.

payroll: Received. We'll tag the record for tax-year reporting and confirm reconciliation within 5 business days. If anything unusual pops up we'll follow up via HR ticket.

ciara: Awesome, closing loop.
